representativeSnapshot.kind: Fresh dedicated Supabase project plus a legacy-data fixture containing two organizations, ambiguous event links, duplicate zone bridges, invalid leads, unsupported scopes, and invalid counts

rowCountQueries: Count site_maps by event_id foreign-key target, event_v2_id, legacy_event_id, tour_id, and resolved organization
Count site_map_zones by site map, candidate event-zone identity, lead membership validity, bounds validity, and duplicate bridge
Count staff_zones by event, venue, organization, supervisor validity, count validity, supported scope, and duplicate bridge
Count pre-existing event_zones by canonical scope, source metadata, duplicate identity, invalid status, invalid category, and invalid counts
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: Every resolvable site-map and staff-zone bridge is linked deterministically; unsafe or ambiguous rows remain preserved and are recorded in private.site_map_zone_migration_issues; no tenant identity is guessed

execution.resumeStrategy: Reapply the idempotent migration in an isolated environment, inspect the private review queue, and use an additive forward migration for any failure after the migration version is recorded
execution.resumeCursor: Supabase migration version 20260903120000 plus the primary keys recorded in private.site_map_zone_migration_issues
execution.idempotency: DDL uses IF NOT EXISTS or deterministic drop/recreate operations; bridge inserts reuse source UUIDs with conflict handling; reconciliation updates are predicate-scoped

quarantine.strategy: Preserve unresolved and invalid source rows, fail closed for authorization, detach invalid optional actors or bridges where required, and record exact source identifiers and issue codes for reviewed recovery

constraints: site_map_zones_event_zone_id_fkey NOT VALID then validated after reconciliation
site_map_zones_lead_user_id_fkey NOT VALID then validated after invalid leads are detached
staff_zones_org_id_fkey NOT VALID then validated after reconciliation
staff_zones_event_zone_id_fkey NOT VALID then validated after reconciliation
constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Apply to a fresh database and the representative legacy snapshot; inventory all NOT VALID constraint violations before validation; compare source, canonical, bridge, duplicate, orphan, and quarantine counts; test policies and security-definer routines as Org A, Org B, revoked, unauthenticated, and service-role actors

recovery.rollback: Disable the Admin zone mutation surfaces and canonical bridge consumers, retain source and review-queue rows, and restore behavior only through a reviewed additive migration; never rewrite an applied migration or reset a persistent database
recovery.forwardFix: Add corrected functions, policies, constraints, or reconciliation statements in a later migration, replay only rows identified by the review queue, and repeat the full two-organization and row-count matrix

queries: Compare site_maps, site_map_zones, staff_zones, event_zones, and review-queue row counts before and after migration and idempotent replay
Report duplicate, orphaned, missing, and scope-mismatched event-zone bridges by source table and organization
Inspect RLS enablement, policies, grants, ownership, search_path, volatility, and security mode for every touched table and function
Run direct PostgREST table and RPC tests for same-organization access, Org B denial, forged actor or organization input, revocation, stale session, and unauthenticated access
Verify forced mid-command failure does not leave a source zone and canonical event-zone out of sync
